headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a thrilling 4-6 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, while the Miami Marlins shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0. In other action, the Chicago Cubs outlasted the Washington Nationals 8-6, and the Seattle Mariners fell to the New York Yankees 4-1.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players landing on the injured list. The Athletics placed left-hander José Suarez on the 15-day injured list due to a right hip strain. The Los Angeles Dodgers transferred right-hander Blake Treinen to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. Other teams have also made injury-related moves, including the Boston Red Sox, New York Yankees, Cincinnati Reds, Toronto Blue Jays, Miami Marlins, and San Francisco Giants.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Baltimore Orioles acquiring center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox. The Miami Marlins traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Athletics acquired right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 4-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a hard-fought win against the Cleveland Guardians, outscoring them 6-4. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Esteury Ruiz led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Yankees in 4-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dropped a 4-1 decision to the New York Yankees in a one-sided matchup. Randy Arozarena led the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for Seattle.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place LHP José Suarez on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics left-hander José Suarez has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right hip strain. The injury occurred on an unspecified date.

top_news.title: **Rivas Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas in a trade with the Boston Red Sox. The deal is part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade, with a player to be named later still to be determined.
